d: Short, platinum white hair is styled in a smooth bob with straight bangs and a small dark bow pinned to the side. Narrow, ruby red eyes are shown with one eye closed in a playful wink, set on a youthful face with an adolescent maturity and a slender build. The outfit consists of a purple and blue plaid blazer over a white blouse with a black tie, paired with high-waisted black trousers featuring gold pyramid studs on a belt and gold decorative accents. Signature details include long pearl earrings, a matching long pearl necklace, and dark fingerless gloves.
